query: SELECT Med_drug.prescription_status, SUM(Med_disease.treatment_challenges) AS sum_Med_disease_treatment_challenges FROM disease JOIN drug ON disease.disease_name = drug.disease_name WHERE (Med_disease.treatments != 'radiotherapy' AND Med_drug.brand_name != 'Lo Loestrin FE') OR (Med_drug.brand_name = 'Nucala' AND Med_disease.risk_factors != 'diabetes') GROUP BY Med_drug.prescription_status;
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。 源SQL存在未绑定表限定符：Med_disease, Med_drug；图原样保留，字段归属待核，不能直接执行。所需字段：Med_disease.risk_factors, Med_disease.treatment_challenges, Med_disease.treatments, Med_drug.brand_name, Med_drug.prescription_status, disease.disease_name, drug.disease_name
